CalendarUI - History
====================

An optional add-on for CalendarUI.

Where the base mod and the Province Holidays add-on record holidays -- days
that come round every year -- this one records history: ten events of the
Fourth Era that shaped Skyrim and Tamriel, each on the day it happened.

The Red Year and the fall of Vvardenfell. The Void Nights and the Return of
the Moons. The Great Collapse that buried half of Winterhold. The Thalmor
Ultimatum, the Sack of the Imperial City, the Battle of the Red Ring and the
White-Gold Concordat that ended the Great War. The Markarth Incident, the
death of High King Torygg, and Ulfric's capture at Darkwater Crossing.

These are dated entries rather than recurring ones, so they carry a year and
appear once in the calendar's history rather than on every anniversary. A few
events have no strict canon date; those have been given lore-friendly ones.

Install alongside 10_Vanilla.json (base) and, if you use it, the Province
Holidays add-on. The three are independent -- any combination works.
